info.title: Hub Admin API
info.description: The first checked OpenAPI slice of the Hub REST contract. The document is expanded by domain; streams, terminal sessions and local bridges stay out of ordinary generated JSON operations.

get.description: Reads local launch status without changing it.
Reads connection metadata and public check state; secrets are never returned.

200.description: Connection metadata and Mail account state

get.description: Reads local project facts and service health. It never reads Mail or Notion and never writes or sends a message.

200.description: Local overview with project status rows and system health

get.description: Reads the data version, server time and health snapshot used by the admin fallback poll. It never writes, sends or starts a service.

200.description: Current data version and health snapshot

get.description: Reads the owner's Telegram account status. It never starts a login or returns a session secret.
Reads the owner's WhatsApp linked-device status. It never starts pairing or returns a session secret.
Reads the configured project files and their derived counts. It never sends a message.
Reads local project setup checks and public sending facts. It never changes configuration, reads secrets, or sends a message.

200.description: Project setup checks and public sending facts

get.description: Reads the project's declared Quick Links and resolves Notion database roles through the read-only Notion reader. It never writes to Notion or opens a link on the server.

200.description: Project Quick Links and Notion resolution state

get.description: Reads the cached local system parts and their current state. It never runs a check.
Reads the bounded recent error window from the local operations log.
Reads the configured runtime agent model and advisor settings. It never starts an agent session.
Reads the draft safety rules configured for a project. It never changes a rule or sends a message.
Reads the owner's decision timeline, newest first. It never sends a message.

200.description: One page of activity and view counts

get.description: Reads the legacy draft review queue. It never sends a message.

200.description: Draft review rows and filter counts

get.description: Reads the batches available to the Mail review screen. It never sends a message.

get.summary: List clients not answered by email
get.description: Reads the triage view of clients the agent left outside an email reply. It never sends a message.

200.description: Clients not answered by email and reason counts

get.description: Reads the Hub's inbound Mail projection and lead group. It never sends a message.

200.description: Open inbound messages, Mail reader state and leads

get.description: Reads the stored inbound projection and its related drafts. It never reads or writes Mail.

200.description: Inbound item state and related drafts

get.description: Reads the client's own words from Mail through the server-owned bridge. It never writes Mail.

200.description: Inbound body or a reason it is unavailable

get.description: Reads follow-up sequence enrollment state for the Mail review screen. It never sends or drafts a message.

post.description: Finishes one follow-up enrollment and skips its open step draft when present. It never sends a message.

get.description: Reads the stored lead projection and its optional Notion details. It never changes Notion or sends a message.
Reads the project's follow-up definitions and validation state. It never sends or drafts a message.
Reads stored agent and owner events for one client. It never sends a message.

get.summary: Read one client's stored messenger history
get.description: Reads stored messenger rows only; Mail remains a separate on-demand read.
Reads the indexed knowledge entries for one project. It never sends a message.
Reads one entry's indexed text for the Knowledge row (P128 X6), cut at 12000 characters. It never sends a message.
Reads the recent tone and waiting state from the project agent log. It never sends a message.

200.description: Agent turn tones and waiting state

get.description: Reads the last local checks for the project agent session and its attached capabilities.

200.description: Agent tool checks and attached capabilities

get.description: Reads one row per Mail conversation from the Hub projection. It never sends a message.

get.summary: Find the client a Mail address key names
get.description: Resolves a client's key (his email, or id-<n>) to the client row and its canonical key (P103). It never sends a message.

200.description: The client and his canonical key

get.summary: Read one project Mail conversation header
get.description: Reads the Hub projection for one person, including its unsent draft. It never sends a message.

200.description: Message body or an explanatory note

get.description: Reads the current unsent Mail draft and its safety result without storing or sending anything.

put.summary: Set one client's Mail review marks
put.description: Updates the project-scoped review marks without sending or changing a draft.

post.summary: Create one unsent owner-authored Mail draft
post.description: Creates a draft only. It never sends a message.

get.description: Reads the bounded send audit and stopped scopes. It never sends, cancels, or changes a send.

200.description: Project send history and stopped scopes

get.description: Reads the project-scoped Messenger projection. It never sends a message.
Reads the project-scoped stored conversation. It never sends a message.

post.summary: Create one unsent owner-authored Messenger draft
post.description: Creates a draft only. It never sends a message and does not require an inbound message.

200.description: Updated Messenger chat with the unsent draft

put.description: Replaces owner-authored text in an existing unsent draft. It never sends a message.

post.description: Moves an unsent Messenger draft out of the review queue. It never sends a message.
Restores the owner's last skipped Messenger draft. It never sends a message.
Asks the configured reply provider to prepare an unsent draft. It never sends a message.

200.description: Updated Messenger chat with the prepared draft

put.description: Updates owner-controlled reply rules for a linked chat. It never sends a message.

earlier.description: Number of messages omitted before the bounded returned window.
